paraphrase: Into blind darkness enter those who worship ignorance (avidyā); into greater darkness, as it were, those who delight in knowledge (vidyā). One thing, they say, comes from knowledge, another from ignorance — so we have heard from the wise who explained it to us. One who knows both knowledge and ignorance together crosses death by ignorance and attains immortality by knowledge.
